scope: source-only stage decisions; target Query labels reserved for final scoring

statistical_rule.multiple_comparisons: exploratory; primary rank and decision contrasts frozen before diagnostics

parameter_budget.target_layers: all six official attention blocks, exact Q/V paths from backbone audit
parameter_budget.compute_schedule: pilot a fixed limited rank/budget subset, then source-validation selects one registered primary pair; do not run a full rank-by-layer-by-K Cartesian product

P0.entry: qualified source cohort, independent physical IDs and exact protocol split registered
P0.B3: retrain a direct battery model on the new split or label historical results diagnostic-only
pass_requires: official checkpoint identity verified
both bridge interfaces have prefix semantics
real baseline training completed
CPU/CUDA and batch1/8 QA
query-future deletion/permutation/extreme-perturbation invariance
independent prediction replay
P0.if_pretrained_no_gain: complete bridge/task-consistency diagnostics, retain results and record the continuation risk
P0.training_budget: epochs, updates, validation search allowance and actual memory limits frozen in the run config after engineering pilot

P1.primary_target_set: six-block Q/V, uniformly shared by comparison methods
P1.basis_fit_data: source training only, excluding the evaluated meta-validation protocol
P1.gradient_definition: mean of physical-cell normalized future trajectory loss gradients
P1.zero_gradient_policy: record as unsupported with denominator; never silently turn an undefined capture ratio into evidence
P1.capture_metric: squared_Frobenius(U.T @ G_holdout @ V) / squared_Frobenius(G_holdout), with column-orthonormal U and V
P1.bootstrap_stability_metric: mean of left/right normalized projection overlaps with bootstrap refits

heldout_update_improvement.direction_fit_data: source train; never use the evaluated heldout gradient to optimize that same heldout sample

P1.if_failed: H1_NOT_SUPPORTED; P2 controlled comparisons may continue; P3/P4 large matrices remain stopped and NEGATIVE

P2.search_budget_rule: same number of source-validation LR trials and same optimizer updates for each method; actual LR values registered per method
pass_requires: GRAD_LOWDIM exceeds faithful LoRA-XS and random-core on source development and heldout source protocols
orthogonal weight-SVD control reported to isolate basis direction from Sigma conditioning
primary mean relative MAE gain >= 0.01
paired cell/group bootstrap CI lower bounds > 0
direction of gain consistent across three registered source seeds
rank-matched and actual-parameter curves both reported
P2.if_failed: retain NEGATIVE; do not use P3 gates to retroactively claim the P2 subspace innovation
P2.if_P1_failed: controlled comparison only; no automatic P3/P4 expansion

P3.gate_inputs: current physical cell K100 prefix and trusted known policy only
P3.formula: W0 + U @ diag(drift_gate[cell]) @ C @ diag(abs_gate[cell]) @ V.T
P3.core_zero_caveat: gate gradients at exact C=0 are zero; start from trained P2 C0 or register a core warmup and then verify both gate branches
pass_requires: TWO_VIEW exceeds P2 and STATIC_GATE on fixed source validation
mean relative MAE gain >= 0.01
paired bootstrap CI lower bounds > 0
shuffle intervention weakens the relevant conditioning gain
local-feature support denominators reported
P3.if_failed: retain P2 without dynamic gates for P4; keep P3 negative results

P4.development_gate_data: source meta-validation episodes; any separate target-development set must be registered before use
P4.final_target_query_policy: final target Query labels are reserved for the fully frozen evaluation; do not tune P4 on final Query and call the same Query an independent P5 test
P4.target_core_definition: C_eff = C_source_frozen + delta_core, with delta_core initially zero
P4.lora_baseline_exception: separate registered source-LoRA-to-target-LoRA baseline can update its actual A/B parameters and must report that budget
P4.adaptation_hyperparameters: source meta-validation or valid support-only leave-one-cell-out; 1-shot uses source-selected hyperparameters

jacobian_ridge.weighting: per-cell normalized supported observations, with registered temporal correlation/downsampling
jacobian_ridge.claim: local weighted-square approximation; final score remains cell-mean MAE

pass_requires: K>0 beats the method's own source 0-shot on shared Query cells
low-shot improvement exceeds both standard LoRA and faithful LoRA-XS under matched information access
paired bootstrap and seed/draw uncertainty retained
no cherry-picked support draws
negative-transfer rate per Query cell reported
P4.if_only_beats_lora_but_not_lora_xs: evidence for low adaptation dimensionality; degradation-specific benefit unproven

entry_requires: all structure/hyperparameters/support seeds frozen before target Query scoring
P5.known_prior_art: both frozen U C V.T and gradient-derived frozen bases with a trainable core have existing methods
P5.required_failure_case: MATR_b1c2 if present in eligible locked Query pool, plus all new severe failures
P5.theory_limit: conditional matrix projection and local regularized estimation; no unproved nonlinear generalization or electrochemical-identification claim
